title: What’s Your Perfect Mix? How T-Mix Fits Every Kind of T‑Mobile Member
summary: Sports superfan? Music obsessed? Always planning your next getaway? With T‑Mobile's new T-Mix phone plans, you can use your Picks to personalize your wireless experience and choose the benefits you love most.
body_markdown:
A working mom lets DashPass by DoorDash handle dinner after a day of back-to-back meetings and soccer practice. Newlyweds put Delta miles toward flights for their dream honeymoon in Fiji. A family hits the road with the kids watching cartoons in the backseat while the parents belt out their favorite throwback 2000s hits on Apple Music. And a die-hard Philadelphia football fan visiting family in Seattle catches the weekly kickoff with the ESPN Unlimited plan.


Different people have different ideas of a perfect day. So why should the benefits in their phone plan all be the same?


A recent T‑Mobile survey found that[84% of people](https://www.t-mobile.com/news/un-carrier/t-mobile-introduces-tmix) want more control over what they pay for. After all, nobody likes paying for things they don’t actually use.


That’s the idea behind[T-Mix](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans) , T‑Mobile’s new wireless plans that put you in the driver’s seat. With the Standard, More and Loaded plans, members get Picks they can use to choose benefits that fit their interests and lifestyles, from streaming, travel, food delivery, gaming and more.


And because what you’re into today might not be what you’re into tomorrow, T-Mix gives you opportunities to remix your Picks as your interests and priorities change. Every Pick is built into your plan, so you can swap them in and out without paying more or changing plans. The number of Picks depends on your plan and number of lines, with different benefits requiring different numbers of Picks.


For T‑Mobile, T-Mix is about giving customers a plan built around what they actually want, not what the industry has always offered.


“One-size-fits-all was simple for the industry, but for customers it turned into one-size-fits-nobody,” said Allan Samson, Chief Marketing Officer, T‑Mobile. “T-Mix flips that model, giving customers more say in what matters to them and plans that they can change as their lives change.”


So, what might your mix look like? Whether you’re a binge-watcher, music lover or something else entirely, here are a few examples of the benefits you can choose from to make T-Mix your own.


## Which T-Mix Picks Fit You Best?


### **Binge-Watcher**


You’re the friend who always has a show recommendation. The one who’s already finished the series everyone else is just discovering. You’ve got strong opinions about which movies deserve a sequel, and yes, you’ve probably made good use of those[$5 movie tickets](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers/t-mobile-tuesdays) through T‑Mobile Tuesdays, which serves up free stuff and epic perks every week for members.


Your next watch?[Apple TV](https://www.t-mobile.com/tv-streaming/apple-tv-plus-deal) ,[Hulu](https://www.t-mobile.com/tv-streaming/hulu-on-us-deal) ,[Netflix](https://www.t-mobile.com/tv-streaming/netflix-on-us) and[Paramount+](https://www.t-mobile.com/tv-streaming/paramount-plus) are among the benefits you can choose from, so go ahead and stream the day away. Or the night. Or both. No one’s judging.


**Picks to explore:** Apple TV, Hulu, Netflix, Paramount+


### **Traveler**


Some people collect concert tees (if that’s you, stay tuned). You collect passport stamps, boarding passes and Instagram saves of places you want to visit someday. Your next trip might be months away, but you’ve already started planning what you’ll eat when you get there (and calling ahead for a table is easy with[Live Translation](https://www.t-mobile.com/support/coverage/live-translation) , which translates your phone calls in real time).[Travel](https://www.t-mobile.com/news/offers/the-ultimate-travel-stack-for-t-mobile-members) is your life, and being a T‑Mobile member makes it better.


Whether it’s a long weekend away or a bucket-list adventure,[Delta miles](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/travel/delta-air-lines) can help you get closer to your next destination. Let[Google Gemini](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/google-ai) save you hours of time by creating a personalized itinerary — complete with must-see sights and restaurants near your hotel. Or choose[Optimized Video Calls](https://www.t-mobile.com/support/plans-features/optimized-video-calls) , a new T‑Mobile network feature designed to help keep your video calls smoother and more reliable on supported apps and devices, so you can stay connected with loved ones back home.


**Picks to explore:** Delta miles, Google Gemini, Optimized Video Calls


### **Sports Fanatic**


There’s no such thing as a casual Sunday when your football team is playing. You know the stats, have your game-day rituals down to a science and will absolutely rearrange your plans to catch kickoff.


If you’re a[baseball fan](https://www.t-mobile.com/news/offers/why-baseball-hits-different-at-t-mobile) , you’re already living the good life knowing being a member means getting MLB.TV on Us (when available).


With T-Mix, sports fans can get even more of the action. Think[ESPN Unlimited](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits) for game day and more sports action throughout the season or[XBOX Game Pass](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/xbox-game-pass) when the final whistle blows and it’s time to pick up the controller for a game of your own.


**Picks to explore:** ESPN Unlimited, XBOX Game Pass


### **Music Lover**


There’s a playlist for everything: Monday morning motivation, beast mode at the gym, a family faves session that lets everyone play DJ. For you, music is how you feel your feelings, set the mood or express yourself (yes, there’s a reason you have all those tees).


And if you’re a[festival fan](https://www.t-mobile.com/news/community/your-backstage-pass-to-music-festival-season) , T‑Mobile members already have plenty to look forward to, with more ways to enjoy the show at some of the biggest live music events of the year.


With T-Mix, music lovers can turn up their fandom even more with Picks like[Apple Music](https://www.t-mobile.com/tv-streaming/apple-music) ,[Pandora](https://www.t-mobile.com/tv-streaming/pandora-premium-deal) and[SiriusXM](https://www.t-mobile.com/tv-streaming/sirius-xm-deal) , offering curated music channels, live programming and personalities who know their way around a great playlist. Rock on.


**Picks to explore:** Apple Music, Pandora, SiriusXM


### **Family Multitasker**


It’s 5:30 p.m. Dinner isn’t planned, someone needs a ride to practice and the kids are negotiating screen time with hours you know they don’t have. Sound familiar?


When everyone’s juggling different schedules and interests, a little help goes a long way. Maybe that means an easy dinner on a particularly hectic Tuesday with[DashPass by DoorDash](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/doordash) . Or keeping the kids entertained on a rainy Saturday with toy unboxing videos on[YouTube Premium](https://www.t-mobile.com/tv-streaming/youtube-premium) . And when someone’s due for a[new phone](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits) , you can put your Picks toward one on Us.


When keeping everyone content is practically a full-time job, your benefits might as well pitch in.


**Picks to explore:** DashPass by DoorDash, YouTube Premium, New Phone


### 5 Perks You Get Before You Pick Anything


The best part of T-Mix? Your Picks are only part of the picture. Every plan starts with a foundation of[more reasons](https://www.t-mobile.com/news/community/inside-the-psychology-of-why-we-want-wait-and-act) to love being a T‑Mobile member, from wireless essentials to exclusive perks, experiences and everyday extras including:


1.[America’s Best Network](https://www.t-mobile.com/coverage/network) : Ookla®, a global leader in connectivity intelligence, named T‑Mobile the Best Mobile Network in the U.S. based on real-world speed test data from the first half of 2026. A network like that matters when you’re streaming your favorite show, catching up with friends or checking in from the road.


2.[Wireless Essentials](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans) : Talk, text and data? That’s right. Every plan includes the connectivity you count on every day, with features and data allowances that vary by plan.


3.[T‑Mobile Tuesdays](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers/t-mobile-tuesdays) : Who doesn’t love a little treat? Every line on your account has access to T‑Mobile Tuesdays, which gives members more to look forward to every single week with free stuff, epic prizes and savings on favorite brands.


4.[Travel](https://www.t-mobile.com/membership)[Extras](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/travel) : Members get access to exclusive hotel and rental car perks and can sip back and relax with a free premium drink on all qualifying Delta flights. You just have to link your Delta SkyMiles® and T‑Mobile accounts through T-Life.


5.[Entertainment Experiences](https://www.t-mobiletickets.com/) : Members can get exclusive access to Club Magenta, T‑Mobile’s members-only lounge, at the biggest events of the year like the Las Vegas Grand Prix, MLB All-Star Game, Lollapalooza and Stagecoach as well as exclusive ticket access and premium experiences at[thousands of festivals and events nationwide](https://www.t-mobiletickets.com/) .


[Check out T-Mix](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans)


## Want a Little Bit of Everything? There's a Mix for That, Too.


Of course, most people don’t just fit in one box. You can be a game day maniac who loves a good rom-com binge-fest. A frequent flyer who’s happiest spending Sunday on the couch. Or a parent who spends all week managing everyone else’s schedules but still finds time to make the perfect playlist.


And these are just a few ways to make T-Mix your own. Depending on your plan and number of lines, you can[explore benefits](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits) across entertainment, travel, gaming, AI and more, including Apple Music, Apple TV, Delta miles, DoorDash, ESPN Unlimited, Google Gemini, Hulu, Netflix, Pandora, Paramount+, SiriusXM, XBOX Game Pass and YouTube Premium.


Your interests don’t stand still, either. Maybe you’re all about football this fall but already dreaming of a beach getaway next spring. Or maybe a new hobby, favorite show or family milestone has you thinking about something completely different.


With T-Mix, members have opportunities every three months to revisit their chosen benefits and change eligible Picks as their interests evolve, subject to the benefit terms. And members can put their unused Picks to work whenever they’re ready to try something new.


Because the best mix isn’t about fitting into one category. It’s about finding the benefits that make you, well, *you* .


*Ready to make your mix? Check out[T-Mix](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans) and discover all the ways to make your wireless experience your own.*


Pick allotment is subject to change. Picks have no cash value; they cannot be traded, gifted, or redeemed for cash. Unapplied Picks do not carry over to the next quarter and are not refundable. **Remixing:** How often you can remix depends on the benefit; some benefits let you switch any time, others hold your Picks for a quarter or longer, and device promotions hold Picks for the promotion period. Changing a partner benefit outside a change window may require a fee. **Annual Reselection:** Once a year, we will ask you to reselect benefits with your available Picks. Existing benefits continue when you reselect them. We may change the benefits and the number of Picks a benefit requires at any time. Changes to active benefits start at your next quarter. **Account Changes:** Changes to your account can change how many Picks are available for benefits and may impact active device promotions. If an account change leaves you with fewer Picks than your selected benefits require, you will have an opportunity to update your mix. If you do not, we will notify you before canceling any promotions or benefits to resolve the shortfall. You can only use Picks while your account is on a T-Mix plan in good standing. Benefits and device promotions remain subject to their own terms, including third-party terms where applicable. You may need to manage your existing third-party subscriptions to avoid duplicate charges. See T‑Mobile.com/Picks for more details.


**Delta:** Eligible plan and linked SkyMiles® account 24 hours before qualifying flight within T-Life required. 21+ for alcoholic beverage. Limit 1/person/flight. Additional terms apply. See T-Life for details and full terms.


**XBOX Game Pass:** Play on Smart TV, PC and more devices you already own. (Limits apply)
